'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Israel–Hamas war]]
**[[Israeli invasion of the Gaza Strip (2023–present)|Israeli invasion of the Gaza Strip]]
***[[Israel]]i strikes across [[Gaza Strip|Gaza]] kill at least 27 [[Palestinian]]s. In [[Gaza City]], four are killed in a strike on a [[UNRWA]] school sheltering [[internally displaced person|displaced people]] and six others are killed in a strike on a house. Two people are killed in the [[Sabra, Gaza|Sabra neighbourhood]], and six others are killed in a strike on a [[residential building]] in [[Az-Zawayda]]. '''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2024 Atlantic hurricane season]]
**[[Hurricane Beryl]]
***One-hundred-twenty counties in the [[U.S. state]] of [[Texas]] are under a [[disaster declaration]] as Tropical Storm Beryl approaches the [[Gulf Coast]]. [https://amp.theguardian.com/world/article/2024/jul/07/beryl-storm-landfall-south-texas-houston (''The Guardian'')]
*At least 14 people are killed and others are missing in [[flash flood]]s and [[landslide]]s caused by heavy rain in [[Nepal]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/amp/gallery/2024/7/7/fourteen-killed-in-nepal-as-monsoon-rains-cause-flooding-in-south-asia (Al Jazeera)]
*Thirteen people are injured when an [[elephant]] chases a crowd attending a [[Hinduism in Sri Lanka|Hindu]] [[religious festival]] in [[Kataragama]], [[Sri Lanka]]. [https://english.alarabiya.net/News/world/2024/07/07/sri-lanka-pilgrims-flee-as-elephant-panics-during-procession- (Al Arabiya)]
*The [[Government of Iran|Iranian]] [[Islamic Republic of Iran Navy|naval]] frigate [[IRIS Sahand (2012)|IRIS ''Sahand'']] [[Capsizing|capsizes]] during repairs in the port of [[Bandar Abbas]], [[Iran]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/iranian-warship-capsizes-during-repairs-port-bandar-abbas-2024-07-07/ (Reuters)]
*At least ten people are killed in a fire at a [[nursing home]] in [[Treinta y Tres]], [[Uruguay]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/ten-die-during-fire-nursing-home-uruguay-2024-07-07/ (Reuters)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Niger–United States relations]]
**The [[United States Armed Forces|U.S. military]] withdraws entirely from [[Niger]]'s [[Niger Air Base 201|Air Base 201]] in [[Niamey]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/us-troops-pull-out-nigers-air-base-101-2024-07-07/ (Reuters)]
*[[Syrian–Turkish normalization]]
**[[President of Turkey|Turkish President]] [[Recep Tayyip Erdoğan]] states his intention to invite [[President of Syria|Syrian President]] [[Bashar al-Assad]] for talks in [[Turkey]] with the intention of restoring [[Syria–Turkey relations|relations between the two countries]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/erdogan-invite-assad-talks-restore-turkey-syria-ties-2024-07-07/ (Reuters)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[2024 North America heat waves]]
**[[Las Vegas]], [[Nevada]], United States, reaches {{conv|120|F}}, the city's highest temperature of all time, and surpassing the previous record of {{conv|117|F}} set in July 2021. [https://www.ktnv.com/news/las-vegas-breaks-all-time-record-high-temperature-on-july-7 (KTNV-TV)] [https://www.reviewjournal.com/local/weather/las-vegas-blisters-all-time-record-high-hits-120-degrees-3081651/ (''Las Vegas Review-Journal'')]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2024 French legislative election]]
**[[French nationality law|French citizens]] vote in the second round of legislative elections for the 17th [[National Assembly (France)|National Assembly]] of the [[French Fifth Republic|Fifth Republic]]. [https://www.lemonde.fr/politique/live/2024/07/07/en-direct-legislatives-2024-le-taux-de-participation-pour-le-second-tour-atteint-59-71-a-17-heures_6247441_823448.html (''Le Monde'')]
**[[Exit poll]]s predict a [[hung parliament]], with the [[French Left|left-wing]] [[New Popular Front]] alliance winning the most seats, followed by [[President of France|President]] [[Emmanuel Macron]]'s [[centrist]] [[Ensemble (political coalition)|Ensemble]] [[coalition]] in second place, and the [[far-right]] [[National Rally]] in third place. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/live/ck7gydwgvy8t (BBC News)]
**[[Prime Minister of France|Prime Minister]] [[Gabriel Attal]] announces that he will [[resign]] on July 8. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/french-pm-attal-i-will-hand-my-resignation-monday-morning-2024-07-07/ (Reuters)] 
*[[Confederation of Sahel States]], [[ECOWAS]]
**[[ECOWAS]] states that it risks disintegrating from military and economic insecurity if [[Niger]], [[Mali]], and [[Burkina Faso]] continue their exit to form their own [[Alliance of Sahel States|confederation]], following sanctions and severed diplomatic ties after each state's military [[coup]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/west-african-bloc-says-it-risks-disintegration-if-junta-led-states-leave-2024-07-07/ (Reuters)]
*[[Israel–Hamas war protests in Israel]]
**[[Israelis|Israeli]] [[protester]]s march and block highways across [[Israel]], calling for a [[ceasefire]], the return of all [[Israel–Hamas war hostage crisis|hostages]], and for [[Prime Minister of Israel|Prime Minister]] [[Benjamin Netanyahu]] to step down. [https://apnews.com/article/israel-palestinians-hamas-war-news-july-7-2024-d78b75084f38c98e219e64db588374b8 (AP)]
